- Theme: https://github.com/kitian616/jekyll-TeXt-theme
- Reference repository: https://github.com/UQ-CVLab/Retinal-Video-Dataset (master)
- Stylesheet source: https://uq-cvlab.github.io/Retinal-Video-Dataset/assets/css/main.css
- Retrieved: 2026-10-11

The landing page structure and content-page wrapper/header/footer classes are adapted from the reference site's rendered TeXt templates. Research content, branding, navigation destinations and media have been replaced. Small project-specific media/accessibility styles live separately in styles.css. No original research images, videos or institution logos were copied. No claim is made that the static site runs a Jekyll build.
